Name: NA
Description: Landless peasants are organized by various left-wing groups espousing ""liberation theology"", including ELN, FARC, ELP, MAO, and M-19. Right-wing militias form in early 1982, including MAS and AUC. Increasingly widespread and lucrative drug trafficking permeates both rural and urban society. General amnesty, truce, and entry of Patriotic Union as legal party in 1984 fails to integrate leftist groups. Late in 2004, AUC demobilized nearly 3,000 fighters.
